Frequently Asked Questions

How does PlanBot help with JEE, NEET, and UPSC prep?

PlanBot automatically balances your daily hours across multiple subjects (e.g., Physics, Chemistry, Math/Bio or GS Papers), incorporates spaced revision blocks for error logs and PYQs, and alerts you when study sessions run late.

Can PlanBot handle 12–14 hour daily study schedules?

Yes. PlanBot incorporates mandatory cognitive rest and hydration buffers between 90–120 minute deep work sprints to maintain high retention throughout marathon study days.
